networks.name: receipt_audit
networks.description: Audits a receipt's line items: repeated lines, the gap between the items and the printed total, and the amount plausibly overcharged.
sample_queries: Rice 39.90, milk 45.00, eggs 18.50, eggs 18.50, tomatoes 6.60. The total says 128.50. Was I overcharged?
My receipt says 2 x 18.50 for the same eggs twice, and the total is 130.50. Check it.
Show me the report for these lines so I can read it myself.
Is 45 yuan a fair price for 12 cartons of milk?

peer_policy.note: Local agents and the page's own actions only. No peer site is called.
